newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Meralco B, Ayala Land fall on foreign selling.
newsitem.headline: Meralco B, Ayala Land fall on foreign selling.

text.p: Blue chip issues Manila Electric Corp B (Meralco) and Ayala Land Inc were pulled down in early trading on Thursday by foreign selling, traders said.
"Foreign fund managers continue to underweight the Philippines and there's selling on Meralco and Ayala Land," said Nathan Lozada, assistant vice-president of Paribas Asia Equity.
Meralco B shares fell 11 pesos, or 7.75 percent, to 131 pesos while Ayala Land shed one peso, or 4.35 percent, to 22 pesos in early trade.
"Interest rates are still high and so there's no foreign interest on issues," said Joey Roxas, president at Eagle Equities.
Ayala Land was the biggest loser among property stocks. Both Ayala Land and Meralco were among the top five most heavily traded issues.
